summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of Yummeet (Polish UI) Expo web app at 390x844. Login works for both ala@yummeet.test and bartek@yummeet.test. All 5 tabs render (tab-index/tables/challenges/chats/profile). Verified: Odkrywaj map + pin count (9 miejsc) + cuisine filter (Polska -> 2), Gastro-Trasa A→B (Warszawa→Łódź, 136 km, 4 lokali, pins open with pin-yummeet-score), /pin/new creates pin with redirect to detail, Wyzwania missions (critic_best_dish accept→start→evidence→submit=>Ukończona, XP went up to 105 and card count 8), Specializations save (toast 'Klasa postaci zapisana!'), Cards book (/cards 8 kart in Ofensywne/Defensywne/Specjalne tabs), Tables official event badge+join (12→11 seats, 'Jesteś na liście') and event chat (chat-input/chat-send-button working), Settings privacy toggles (settings-vis-*), Profile logout (profile-logout-button) returns to Login screen, Duel invite A→B accepted and Bartek played rps-rock-button, duel-status transitions to 'Runda ataku'. Map tiles show overlapping 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermarks because CARTO basemap is used without an API key — pins and route lines render on top but this is unsightly. One missed testID expectation: tasks mentioned reviewing via review-food-5/service-5/ambience-5/value-5 which are present but review-submit-button toast was not captured consistently (likely timing — Zapisz ocenę button is present and screen state suggests submit works, but needs confirmation). All toasts use testID 'toast-text' as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: Base map tiles show 'API KEY REQUIRED - carto.com/basemaps/apikey' watermark everywhere (visible on /, /route, /pin/new). Pins and route lines render but background is unusable. Likely needs a MapTiler/MapTilerCloud/CARTO API key or switch to free OSM tiles.

issues: No logout button on /settings — logout lives only on Profile tab (profile-logout-button). Consider adding settings-logout for discoverability. User instructions assumed logout from Settings.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Harmless but should be migrated. Likely in a shared Button/Icon component.

action_items: Fix Leaflet basemap: provide EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY (or similar) or switch to {s}.tile.openstreetmap.org (free) in the map iframe/webview — currently 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark covers every tile on Odkrywaj, Gastro-Trasa map and /pin/new.
Optionally add a settings-logout Button on /settings for parity with user expectations; logout is currently only on Profile tab.
Migrate pointerEvents prop usage to style.pointerEvents (React Native deprecation warning in console).

Verify review submission on pin detail — the review-food-5/service-5/ambience-5/value-5 and review-submit-button are wired but a toast was not consistently captured; a short regression over this flow is suggested.
critical_code_review_comments: Map basemap is broken in production preview due to missing CARTO/MapTiler API key — route and pin discovery UX looks unprofessional.
Logout is only on profile tab; settings screen has settings-delete-account but not settings-logout — minor UX inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST pin ('TEST Pin Yummeet' in Warszawa, polish cuisine) under Ala; sent one chat message in official event chat ('TEST wiadomość z testu'); accepted mission critic_best_dish (now Ukończona for Ala); set Ala primary spec to critic; sent duel invite Ala→Bartek which Bartek accepted and played Rock. These are left in DB intentionally — test accounts not deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both ala@yummeet.test and bartek@yummeet.test exist and work. Public URL https://yummeet-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Use 390x844 viewport. Toasts use testID 'toast-text'. All critical testIDs verified: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, tab-index/tables/challenges/chats/profile, discover-pin-count, discover-route-button, route-a-input/route-a-search/route-a-result-0, route-b-input/route-b-search/route-b-result-0, route-run-button, route-summary, route-pin-*, pin-yummeet-score, new-pin-title-input, new-pin-cuisine-polish, new-pin-save-button, mission-card-*, mission-accept-button, mission-start-button, mission-evidence-input, mission-submit-button, spec-primary-*, spec-save-button, card-*, event-card-*, event-join-button, event-chat-button, chat-input, chat-send-button, duel-new-button, duel-search-input, duel-invite-*, duel-accept-button, duel-reject-button, duel-status, rps-rock-button, settings-vis-profile/stats/cards, settings-duel-mode, settings-notif-*, settings-delete-account, profile-logout-button. There is NO settings-logout testID. For duels, Ala already has an unresolved duel with Bartek awaiting her move in round 1 (she needs to play RPS). Map 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark is NOT a test flake — real missing CARTO API key.
rca_of_issue: Map 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark RCA: The web preview uses an iframe/WebView loading Leaflet with a CARTO basemap URL (e.g., basemaps.cartocdn.com/.../apikey). Without a valid key, CARTO stamps every tile with the watermark. Fix: supply EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY/CARTO key via env and inject into the tile URL template, or fallback to free OSM tiles (https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) with proper attribution.
